paper.title: Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP): The Holy Grail for Day Trading Systems
paper.abstract: VWAP-based day trading strategy: long when price > VWAP, short when price < VWAP. Tested on QQQ/TQQQ 2018-2023. QQQ: $25K -> $192,656 (671%, MDD 9.4%, Sharpe 2.1). TQQQ: $25K -> $2,085,417 (8,242%, MDD 36.1%, Sharpe 1.7). Buy-and-hold QQQ: 126% (MDD 35.6%, Sharpe 0.7).

key_findings.evidence: Above VWAP candles repriced +$320 over 5 years; Below VWAP repriced -$280. 56% of candles above VWAP in uptrend.
key_findings.application: VWAP crossover is a valid trend signal for intraday trading

key_findings.finding: VWAP Trend Trading outperforms all SMA variants
key_findings.evidence: VWAP: 671% total return, Sharpe 2.1, MDD 9.4%. SMA9: 202% (Sharpe 1.3), SMA200: 135% (Sharpe 0.9). Buy&Hold: 126% (Sharpe 0.7).
key_findings.application: VWAP is superior to SMA9/20/100/200 for intraday trend detection

key_findings.finding: Low hit ratio but high gain:loss asymmetry
key_findings.evidence: 17% hit ratio, but gains are 5.5x larger than losses (QQQ) and 5.48x (TQQQ). Max trade gain QQQ 6.5%, TQQQ 20.9%.
key_findings.application: Trend-following with wide stops and tight loss control is profitable despite low win rate

key_findings.evidence: Most profits come from 9:30-12:00 ET and 15:00-16:00 ET. Midday (12:00-15:00) shows no significant trend.
key_findings.application: Avoid VWAP trading during midday hours; focus on open and close

key_findings.evidence: Beta coefficient not statistically different from zero. Alpha = 38% annualized (QQQ), 93% (TQQQ), t-stat > 4.
key_findings.application: VWAP strategy provides true diversification; profits in both bull and bear markets

key_findings.finding: Commissions are the main cost driver
key_findings.evidence: TQQQ: $400,616 commissions on $2M profit. QQQ: $6,547 commissions on $192K profit. ~22,000 trades over 5.75 years.
key_findings.application: High-frequency VWAP requires low-cost execution; commission impact scales with leverage

strategy_rules.name: VWAP Trend Trading
strategy_rules.session: Regular trading hours only (9:30-16:00 ET), no overnight positions
strategy_rules.entry_long: First 1-min candle closes above VWAP at 9:31am ET
strategy_rules.entry_short: First 1-min candle closes below VWAP at 9:31am ET
strategy_rules.exit_long: 1-min candle closes below VWAP (stop loss) or 4:00pm ET close
strategy_rules.exit_short: 1-min candle closes above VWAP (stop loss) or 4:00pm ET close
strategy_rules.position_sizing: 100% of available equity, no leverage (or 3x with TQQQ)
strategy_rules.slippage: Assumed zero for small accounts; scales with size

limitations: Exploratory study; past performance not indicative of future results
Not suitable for multi-million dollar funds due to liquidity constraints
Requires 1-minute data and intraday execution capability
Mean-reverting days cause significant losses (up to -22.7% daily on TQQQ)
No fundamental analysis; purely technical trend-following

relevance_to_crypto.applicability: HIGH — crypto markets trade 24/7, so VWAP must be computed on rolling windows or anchored to session opens (UTC)
adaptations: Use rolling 24h VWAP or anchor to daily open (00:00 UTC) instead of RTH
Crypto has no market close; use time-based exits (e.g., 4h, 8h, or trailing VWAP)
Higher volatility in crypto may require wider stops or reduced position sizing
Volume data quality varies by exchange; use high-liquidity pairs (BTC, ETH, SOL)
Consider funding rates for perpetual futures as additional signal
relevance_to_crypto.kraken_specific: Kraken provides OHLCV with volume via ccxt; VWAP computable from 1m or 15m candles

integration_notes.hermes_trading: Add as vwap_trend strategy alongside ICT and momentum strategies
integration_notes.backtesting: Use existing backtest framework with 1m or 15m Kraken data
integration_notes.risk_management: Apply existing daily loss limits and drawdown circuits
integration_notes.live_execution: Mirror to LiveKrakenTrader with small_capital profile

crypto_backtest.finding: The naive paper port (0.15% band, exit on first VWAP touch) LOSES money on crypto 15m: 205 trades, 11.7% hit, G:L 0.14, -112% aggregate. Fee drag + chop dominate. This is the paper's own 'false VWAP breaks / mean-reverting day' failure mode, amplified by higher crypto range and per-trade fees.
crypto_backtest.conclusion: Only the most selective config (>=1.5% distance band + multi-bar hold) is marginally profitable on this window. +1.21% on 11 trades is thin and likely within noise. Deployed vwap_min_distance_pct=1.5 as the only viable setting, but this strategy is UNPROVEN on crypto and should be paper-tracked, not trusted with size, until MCPT confirms edge over a longer horizon.
crypto_backtest.verdict: PAPER-TRACK ONLY — edge does not transfer naively from QQQ 1m to crypto 15m
